description:
Cusdis comment plugin configurations
DEPRECATED: Cusdis was archived on July 17, 2026. Use another comment system instead.
https://cusdis.com/doc

app_id.description: App ID of the website in the embed code from the Cusdis dashboard

host.description: URL of your Cusdis server if you host it yourself

theme.description: Theme of Cusdis: light, dark, or auto to follow the system color scheme. Follows the appearance of the theme (the data-appearance attribute of <html>) if not set

lang.description: Language of Cusdis, e.g., zh-cn, zh-tw, es, or fi. Uses English if not set
